command: set -e; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; APK=$(cat /tmp/phase1c_apk_path); rm -f /tmp/phase1c_control.pcm /tmp/phase1c_control.wav; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell rm -f /data/local/tmp/phase1c_control.pcm; cleanup(){ python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py hangup >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py dial 510100100; OFF=0; for i in $(seq 1 50); do ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo control_call_state=$ST; if [ "$ST" = "2" ]; then OFF=1; break; fi; sleep 0.4; done; test "$OFF" = "1"; sleep 6.3; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell "CLASSPATH=$APK app_process /system/bin pl.michalmatu.aicallbridge.ShellAudioProbe capture-downlink 5000 /data/local/tmp/phase1c_control.pcm"; python3 scripts/s22_call_control.py hangup; trap - EXIT; sleep 1.5; ST=$(adb -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys telephony.registry | sed -n 's/.*mCallState=\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -n1); echo after_control_state=$ST; test "$ST" = "0"; adb -s "$SERIAL" pull /data/local/tmp/phase1c_control.pcm /tmp/phase1c_control.pcm >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell rm -f /data/local/tmp/phase1c_control.pcm
